integrity: The three first-step coefficients and universal reversal are proved analytically; 3695 exact-rational assertions are finite corroboration. The reported review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric negative-definite Lyapunov drift, rank-one positive-semidefinite forcing, first one-dimensional Krylov projection, exact arithmetic. No higher-step or nonsymmetric conclusion; novelty remains subject to publication-priority uncertainty.
title: Universal first-step residual–error reversal for Lyapunov PMR
